h1.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Bearing (mechanical)

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does list Theoretical Output 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical).
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油30型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行标出了理论输送量15 m³/h和最大出口压力20 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical)。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical). Subject: Bearing (mechanical). Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The frame “Crane (machine)” shows View in Cape Town CBD, from the Corner of Roeland Street and adds no stroke figure. Maximum aggregate size is 3 cm and below. It is not a measured stroke for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical)。画面主体：Bearing (mechanical)。河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油30型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。柴油30型混凝土泵这一行不会把那些名称变成扭矩、小时间隔，或这一行没有写出的材料牌号。管路长度仍要读这个型号自己的距离格，不读这一帧，也不读另一台泵。

body.en: The row does list Theoretical Output 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. Main-unit weight is 2000 kg. Theoretical Output 15 m³/h.
body.zh: 这一行标出了理论输送量15 m³/h和最大出口压力20 MPa。最大骨料粒径 3 cm and below。

body.en: A piston displaces concrete into the line. a squeeze pump compresses a hose. This Diesel 30 Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already lists. Subject: View in Cape Town CBD, from the Corner of Roeland Street. Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa.
body.zh: 画面「Crane (machine)」的主体是View in Cape Town CBD, from the Corner of Roeland Street，也没有补上行程数字。主体：View in Cape Town CBD, from the Corner of Roeland Street。

body.en: The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. Hopper capacity is 0.3 m³. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance entries, not from the frame and not from a different pump.
body.zh: 另一份易损件清单用外径列出活塞和摆臂类替换件。如果画面里能看到活塞或阀，那只是这一帧的主体。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 Concrete Pump list a piston stroke?
question.zh: 柴油30型混凝土泵标出了活塞行程吗？

answer.en: No. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical).
answer.zh: 没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical)画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 那标出了什么工作参数？

answer.en: Theoretical Output 15 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 20 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical).
answer.zh: 理论输送量15 m³/h，最大出口压力20 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical)画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical).
answer.zh: 没有。小时、扭矩和价格都没有标出。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bearing_(mechanical)画面里印出的数字。
